EmbryoGenesis – Infertility Diagnostic & Research is an infertility diagnostic and research centre at the Rayat Bahra University campus in Mohali, Punjab, India.

Our center leads in reproductive health diagnostics, offering tailored solutions to help couples overcome challenges and achieve their parenthood dreams.

Therapeutic Services

Explore advanced therapies like LIT Therapy, Stem Cell Therapy, PRP, and Molecular Hydrogen Therapy. Our personalized treatments improve reproductive health and help couples achieve their dream of parenthood.

LIT Therapy

Enhance fertility with LIT Therapy, a personalized immune-modulation treatment to overcome immune-related infertility challenges like recurrent miscarriages.

Book Now: LIT Therapy →

PBMC Therapy

Boost your chances of conception with PBMC Therapy, which uses immune cells to create a healthier environment for successful implantation and pregnancy.

Book Now: PBMC Therapy →

PRP Therapy

Regenerate reproductive tissues with PRP Therapy, a cutting-edge technique that improves blood flow and supports fertility for couples facing challenges.

Book Now: PRP Therapy →

Stem Cell Therapy

Harness the regenerative power of stem cells to address fertility challenges and improve reproductive health. Our advanced therapy offers hope for couples seeking innovative solutions.

Book Now: Stem Cell Therapy →

Molecular Hydrogen Therapy

Boost your fertility with Molecular Hydrogen Therapy, designed to combat oxidative stress and enhance reproductive well-being naturally and effectively.

Book Now: Molecular Hydrogen Therapy →

FAQs

What can I expect during these diagnostic tests?

Each test includes a comprehensive consultation, a simple collection process, and a detailed explanation of results. Our specialists ensure you feel informed and supported throughout.

How soon will I get my results?

Results are typically available within 7-10 days, depending on the complexity of the test. We prioritize accuracy and timely reporting to help you move forward confidently.

Will these tests help if I’ve already had IVF treatments?

Absolutely. Our diagnostic tests are particularly beneficial for those who have faced IVF failures or unexplained fertility issues. They provide deeper insights that standard tests may miss.
